activities:
Prepare, approve and adopt guidelines for Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) for all crops and farming systems, while identifying relevant indicators, for all crops and farming systems
Adopt need-based Crop Prioritization (national and provincial needs, environmental concerns/agro-ecology, productivity, return to investment, export) and Crop Zoning
Introduce measures to minimize temporal variation in productivity with appropriate varieties, production technologies and Agro-met Advisories (AMAs) based on climate forecasting

Adopt Precision Agriculture systems (e.g., new technologies for higher fertilizer use efficiency, soil test-based fertilizer application) to enhance productivity and minimize negative impacts to ecosystem

Facilitate new technology generation and adoption (e.g., varieties, production packages, etc.)
Manage wildlife, based on the carrying capacity of ecosystems (sustainable management – minimizing impacts on agriculture and natural ecosystems), and minimize their impact through scientifically-valid population control of animals
Improve productivity of existing farm units (with assured financial assistance to smallholders)
Introduce low-interest loan schemes (credit) to facilitate agricultural production and productivity

text: Constitute a centrally-controlled information development and dissemination system to manage research, development and extension systems, and recruitment related to the agriculture sector
label: Agricultural information system

sources.sourceText:
14. Constitute a centrally-controlled information development and dissemination system to 
manage research, development and extension systems, and recruitment related to the 
agriculture sector
sources.section: Thematic Area: Knowledge Management and Agricultural Extension

sources.sourceText:
Policy Statement 
14. 
Constitute a centrally-controlled information development and dissemination 
system to manage research, development and extension systems, and 
recruitment related to the agriculture sector

activities:
Establish a demand-driven agriculture research program in aching national development goals
Provide appropriate incentives (financial & physical) to promote R&D for technology development
Invest on research and development to produce hybrids and high yielding varieties of priority crops through private-public partnership
Facilitate and strengthen agriculture education at primary, secondary and tertiary levels
Establish real-time agriculture data base with continuous updating and easy public access
Incorporate agriculture progressively as a compulsory subject at least until GCE O/L examination (KSA)
Incorporate more skills development in ancient agriculture technologies and modern on a need-based approach to the agriculture curricular in diploma and undergraduate levels
Adopt a market oriented agricultural extension system
Strengthen PPP to ensure effective information dissemination to the producers
Establish a centrally coordinated agriculture extension system with a stronger link between the DOA, PDOA, Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka and Private Sector extension setup
Re-visit the grass root level extension modalities including the fresh recruitment of extension officers at grass root level/village level. With minimum qualification of NVQ level 4
Create awareness and promote adoption of novel technologies – use of mobile/data-tabs technologies for information dissemination and real-time feedback (For AIs, ARPAs, Presidents of Farmer Committees at ASCs)
Provide advisory and advocacy to support evidence-based decision making of farmers
